Marta (CS): Quick compact runbook for tomorrow's demo->prod handoff. Goals: avoid cold starts, keep token spend steady, capture a renewal signal. Need eng + SE ack.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Love it. Suggestion: prefill 50 prefixes, warmup 2h before demo. Telemetry: cache_hit_rate, p95_latency_ms, token_count, renewal_risk.

Jamal (Eng-SRE): Ops knobs: cache_ttl=900s for onboarding orgs; max_batch_latency=25ms for interactive routes; streaming_initial_chunk_tokens=64. Fallback: quantized model when queue_depth > 70%. Add cache rollback on error_rate >2%.

Marta (CS): Customer-facing mini-runbook (copy):
- Preflight: confirm API key, billing, model choice.
- Warmup: run 50 synthetic requests matching demo prompts.
- Cache: enable prefix cache TTL=900s; expect cache_hit_rate >=60%.
- Streaming: enable streaming initial chunk=64 tokens.
- Batching: set max_batch_latency=25ms, confirm p95 target.
- Fallbacks: configure fallback_model (quantized).
- Feedback: one-question in-demo pulse "Was this helpful? yes/no". Negative -> set renewal_risk=true.

Ethan (CSM): Owners: Marta -> runbook + pulse copy; Priya -> SDK & warmup script; Jamal -> ops checklist + canary. I'll schedule kickoff.

Marta (CS): Plan: publish the mini-runbook to onboarding docs and share 1h before demo. Will confirm after cache hits observed.
